system.description:
You are treated as having "Instant Focus" at SR 1. If you already have it, your "Instant Focus" changes to "Uses: 2 per scene". [Trigger: Refer] Use when you are subject to forced movement. Reduce that movement by 1 Sq. A piece of armor incorporating an unknown mechanism believed to be part of a magic war machine. Its properties change according to the wearer, and it also has various functions to assist in actions.

Counter-Through Magic Armor [Core Material] (120G) + Traveler's Tunic (270G) + Plate Mail (30,000G) + [Magic Catalyst 8] (70G) ×3 + Crafting Cost (340G)
